audience: Linda, 66, a single retired Ohio school administrator living on USD 2,350 a month Social Security plus a USD 900 pension and USD 140,000 in savings, planning a Chiang Mai move in October 2027.
localeReason: English only: the scenario is a specific US retiree dealing with Thai immigration, US Medicare and US–Thai tax questions, and the sources are English-language government and company pages. No translation was made.

planningAssumptions.fxAssumption: 35 THB per USD, planning convention only; stress case 30 THB per USD
planningAssumptions.recommendation: Non-Immigrant O retirement visa then annual retirement extensions in Thailand; Thai-bank deposit route preferred for the first extension if feasible; keep Medicare Part B while a US return is plausible; buy suitable Thai health cover
planningAssumptions.qualification: Social Security assumed gross; if net of Part B, remove the duplicate deduction. Tax, car, long-term care, uninsured major illness, US plan premiums and one-off moving costs are outside the budget. Not legal, tax or insurance advice.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: No network. README Locale contract and VOICE-GUIDE read first; batch37 Manila page and data, HCMC pages and batch38 extra-locale examples read for conventions. Only the assigned run folder was read: index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md in full.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Early discovery used managed browser profiles whose cookie state was not proved clean, so a clean-session guarantee cannot be given for those calls; later reads used a fresh context. Three Thai government pages were read through browser fallback. The retirement-order Gazette PDF text was unreadable and was not translated. No insurer, hospital, agent or authority was contacted and no quote was requested.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: The separate check recomputed every budget row and derived amount at 35 THB/USD and found them correct. It found one error, the projected age on arrival (67/68), which was corrected to 66 or 67 in the run's page and ledger; this guide uses 66 or 67. It did not certify the newer immigration order, 2027 prices, personal underwriting or tax, or catastrophic-care pricing.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: The run's own page was layout-tested at 1440, 390 and 320 px. No build, browser, visual, accessibility or print check was performed for these new files.

datePolicy: All source access dates keep 7 November 2026 from the run's ledger, not the authoring date. Published dates inside sources, offer end dates and the October 2027 move date are kept separate; no external refresh.
